title: Amtrak reliability hold: named station and railcar cohorts lack uptime and use results
summary: Amtrak's named station completions and railcar ramp installations establish delivery cohorts, but the report does not publish compatible feature availability, outages, maintenance, actual use, complaints, or rider experience for those same cohorts. Denominator: The eleven substantial-completion stations, eight final-completion stations, three matched stations, and 141 completed ramp-equipped cars already fixed in Phase 57B.
key_findings: Finding: Amtrak's named station completions and railcar ramp installations establish delivery cohorts, but the report does not publish compatible feature availability, outages, maintenance, actual use, complaints, or rider experience for those same cohorts.
Denominator: The eleven substantial-completion stations, eight final-completion stations, three matched stations, and 141 completed ramp-equipped cars already fixed in Phase 57B.
Boundary: Completion is not feature availability over time.
Boundary: Installed ramps are not trip-level service or use.
Boundary: No compatible outage, maintenance, use, complaint, boarding-time, or rider-experience series is public.
Next action: Reopen with the same named station and railcar identifiers, compatible periods, feature uptime, outages, maintenance, actual use, complaints, boarding time, and rider experience.
why_it_matters: The visible hold prevents delivery, serviceability, planning, or component records from being presented as reliability, adoption, recurring output, accepted capacity, or a complete program baseline.
